# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RETEST_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the first 15-minute opening range, price often reverts to the intraday VWAP as dynamic support, providing a mean-reversion long edge when the ribbon is bullish and volatility is low. This captures intraday mean-reversion momentum that occurs after initial opening range breakouts fail to sustain.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If price closes above the opening range high (ORH) and then, within the next two 5-min bars, touches or crosses the VWAP, enter long at the close of the bar that touches VWAP, provided the 9-EMA > 21-EMA (bullish ribbon) and VIX < 20. Exit shape: Initial stop at the opening range low (ORL); target 1.5R; if price reaches 1R, move stop to break-even; allow a runner to trail using a 2× ATR trailing stop from highest close.
